studies.title: The Roman road map
studies.caption: A long roll draws the empire's roads from Britain to India as one strip, with distances between stations: the map we know as the Tabula Peutingeriana.
studies.prompt: Wide close view of a long narrow Roman route-map roll partly unrolled across a table about350CE; parallel bands of land and water, thin red road network, tiny stylized towns. A traveller points at a route. No geographic modern projection, no legible invented Latin, no medieval bound atlas.
